title: Quick Melted Cheese Turkish Stone-Bowl Dish
description: A rich, cheesy Turkish dish that's easy to make in just 25 minutes and perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Dolsot stone bowl
ingredients.notes: Preheated in oven at 400°F (200°C) for 10 minutes.

instructions: Preheat the dolsot stone bowl in the oven at 400°F (200°C) for 10 minutes.
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the garlic, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the mozzarella cheese and cook, stirring constantly, until melted and smooth.
Stir in the feta cheese until well combined.
Remove the dolsot stone bowl from the oven and carefully pour the cheese mixture into the bowl.
Return the bowl to the oven and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly and slightly golden brown.
Remove the bowl from the oven and top with chopped parsley.
